_comment: Image Comparison Pipeline — DAG configuration. The Dataflow job owns window/status management: it reads the earliest PENDING row from the lookup table, marks it RUNNING, runs, then marks DONE or FAILED. The DAG is a pure scheduler — no window fetching or status updates needed here.

pipeline._comment_filter: Leave human_filter_field blank to disable payload filtering.
pipeline._comment_segments: Each segment maps a pair of method values to a segment name written into the 'segment' column of every output row. For combined segments (multiple human payloads per image), list humanSubTypes with discriminatorField per sub-type. Use mergeArrayFields to concatenate shared arrays (e.g. documentProofs) across sub-types instead of replacing.

segments._comment: Standard single-payload segment. case_id-bearing — human payloads for the same image+segment are merged across cases (see FilterAndPairFn.mergeAcrossCases), so mergeArrayFields concatenates each of these list fields across cases (paired by the same composite key FlattenAndCompareFn.ARRAY_MATCH_KEYS uses for comparison) instead of one case's array wholesale-replacing another's.
segments.name: main
segments._comment_atomic: creditReportHeader is one holistic record, not a set of independently-collidable fields — its non-slot fields are taken wholesale from the latest case rather than blended field-by-field. The three listed sub-objects are each their own self-contained dispute-request record (with internalComments/images/status/maintenance/disputeCodes of their own) and are resolved as independent named slots: the latest case's version wins if it has that slot, otherwise an earlier case's version is carried forward instead of lost.
segments._comment_merge_key: addresses is compared against AI by content (streetNumber-postalCode, see ARRAY_MATCH_KEYS in FlattenAndCompareFn), but merged across cases by addressType (Current, Former1, Former2, ...) instead — a disputed address's street/postal can itself be the thing being corrected, so content can't reliably identify 'the same slot' across cases for merge purposes.
segments._comment_priority: When two cases' versions of the same address slot (paired by addressType per mergeItemKeyField above) differ, the version carrying addressRequested (i.e. actively disputed) wins outright, even over a more recent but undisputed resubmission of that same slot.

segments._comment: Combined authentication + docreview segment. Authentication and docreview human payloads arrive under different method values and are merged before AI comparison. The documentProofs array is tagged per sub-type, filtered, then concatenated into the merged record.
segments.name: authanddocreview

humanSubTypes._comment: Authentication sub-type: payload contains both verifiedData and documentProofs. Stamps every documentProofs item with authenticationType=Authentication.
humanSubTypes.name: authentication

humanSubTypes._comment: DocReview sub-type (merge base): payload contains documentProofs but NOT verifiedData. negativeDiscriminatorField ensures auth payloads (which also have documentProofs) are not misclassified here, regardless of sub-type ordering.
humanSubTypes.name: docreview
